title: adhatoda protracta
intro: Adhatoda protracta, commonly known as Vasa, is a medicinal plant belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda protracta include its ability to relieve coughs, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as vasicine and vasicinone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
